Can you hea-WWwW|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 36 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|ERROR: Incoming mysterious enemies!|Beginning of Wave 36 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Error''' was a very fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. While it has somewhat low health compared to other enemies that spawn during its debut (like the [[Tank]] or [[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]]), its speed is high enough to overcome weaker defenses. The '''Error''' also has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes it immune to the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]'s stun, being only slowed down and makes it immune to knockback. The '''Error''' can be spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, Wave 43 onwards and in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode, Wave 37 onwards. ==Appearance== The '''Error''' is a chaotic multi-colored enemy with no face. It has a red head, left arm and right leg. It also has a salmon colored torso and left leg. It has a yellow right arm, which holds a very reflective navy DVD disk. On its torso is an emblem of a navy DVD. It emits large glitch particles of various colors from its torso. It also plays a brief error sound upon death. It runs with both of its arms pointing upwards, flailing. ==Strategy== *The strategy against the '''Error''' is mostly the same as the strategies to be used against the [[Glitch]], but keep in mind that the '''Error''' has much higher health compared to the [[Glitch]], and also appears in conjunction with tougher enemies, like the [[Tank]], [[Boomer]], [[Summoner Boss]]. **Using towers that deal high DPS, such as the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]], are highly recommended against the '''Error'''. ***While the [[Accelerator]] can be used against '''Errors''', be aware of its charge-up time. The delay may allow some '''Errors''' to get past. ***The [[Commander]] is almost essential against the '''Error''' as the firerate boost it provides can allow towers to attack the '''Error''' more often before it moves out of range. ***The [[DJ Booth]] can also be very helpful, as the range boost will keep '''Errors''' in the range of towers for longer. *The [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]] and [[Warden]] can be used to slow this down. **Do note that the [[Stun Immunity]] that the '''Error''' has causes stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] to only slow it down instead of stunning it while knockback towers will not knock it back. **The [[Sledger]] may not be able to attack all the '''Errors''' that enter its range as its range is short. However, if timed correctly, it can freeze multiple '''Errors''' at once. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} ErrorPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseError.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} April Fools 2022 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Error''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- 🌵 BADLANDS Trailer! 🌵|'''Error''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ErrorIconIG.png|'''Error''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Error''' may be a reference to [https://www.roblox.com/games/2546178603/DVD-MAN DVD Man] (originating from one of M.U.G.E.N.s' games). *The '''Error''' may be inspired by ''Tower Battles's'' [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Error|Error]] from [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Wave 0000000|Wave 0000000]]. *The '''Error's''' disc may look different on different angles depending on the map. **This is due to it being very reflective. *As its name suggests, the '''Error''' makes [https://www.roblox.com/library/550209561/error an error sound] when it dies. *The '''Error''' is a variant of the [[Glitch]], which also appears in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
